I've also noticed the mining cycle circles around every couple of years as the mining tech changes. I cpu mined btc/ltc, which then paid for GPUs when the price spiked, then got asics with the gpu mined coins when it jumped again. I mined several popup and mine/dump coins along the way too. So I don't actually have that much in it. I'm really happy with all that I learned along the way. Setting up all those video cards was a huge learning experience and just a lot of fun.

I still don't recommend mining if you have any expectation of making a profit right away. The daily mining/cashout calculators are never right and it gives false expectations to daily output vs. costs. It's a long term strategy that requires keeping the equipment going with the chance that the market will swell again when new miners hit the market and the difficulty spikes again.
